description: This Dart source file defines the RetryPolicy class, which provides functionality for executing asynchronous operations with retries using exponential backoff and jitter. It includes configuration options for maximum attempts, base delay, and maximum delay, and implements the retry logic with proper exception handling.

classes.name: RetryPolicy
classes.description: A helper class that executes asynchronous functions with retries, incorporating exponential backoff with jitter.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs an asynchronous function with retry logic, catching exceptions and retrying with increasing delays until success or maximum attempts are reached.
